registry.item_title: Number of Participants With With First Occurrence of All-Cause Mortality

item_title_witness.text: Number of Participants With With First Occurrence of All-Cause Mortality

notes: The matching registry outcome reports all-cause mortality separately for During treatment (OG000 6; OG001 5), Within 30 days of treatment discontinuation (OG000 1; OG001 1), and After 30 days of treatment discontinuation (OG000 10; OG001 4). It does not print an overall all-cause mortality count for either group. Overall events and event witnesses are null: summing periods is prohibited, and selecting a single period would narrow the requested outcome. Denominators are the matching measure's full-analysis-set denoms. The held PMID 28824029 abstract prints 17 deaths among 111 eplerenone participants and 10 among 110 placebo participants; these cannot replace mandatory registry-owned counts. The adverseEventsModule has no all-cause mortality totals; its Sudden cardiac death and Sudden death terms are narrower outcomes. Cardiovascular mortality and mortality/hospitalization composite measures are also not the requested outcome.
